oof_candidate.drop_reason: zero isolated positive labels; outer hit losses were a joint-action effect
oof_candidate.rr_multiplier_rule: lock to 1.0, the inner-selected value in four of five outer folds
oof_candidate.threshold_rule: select an activation quantile using only cross-fitted train_explore utilities under every-fold safety; map that fixed quantile to the unlabeled full-model train_explore utility distribution, because raw probability scales differ across fitted models

fresh_validation_source.target_rule: catalog target must occur in train source and must not occur anywhere in the pinned validation CSV
fresh_validation_source.family_rule: catalog family signature must not occur among any catalog target in the pinned validation CSV; fresh selection and confirmation must also be mutually family-disjoint
fresh_validation_source.reason: excluding the entire validation-source target/family universe guarantees disjointness from all old proxy splits, including sealed confirmation, without reading the sealed file

compact_cache.goal: one expensive target-blind pass, then sub-second metric and gate audits
